about: Owner-declared entries of the v5 resolve / traverse deploy gate (gate_policy.py --declared): what the MCP surface cannot show, carried over from declared_v4_rt.json section 1 (approved by the owner on 2026-10-14; the scenario ids are v5's, which keep v4's). Nothing else: the v4 suite errors of declared_v4_rt.json (T-labels-0004, T-budget-0003, T-attempts-0002 r1, REL-prefix_equals-0001/0002/0003) are fixed by v5, R-budget-0001/0002 stay required on direct-local (the owner, 2026-10-15), and the long walks' budget_stress exclusions derive from their tag in gate_policy.py (owner-approved 2026-10-15: T-longwalk-0001..0004). Decided by the owner, never inferred from an answer a run received; each entry names its evidence.

exclusions.reason: the MCP's traverse_capabilities answers the service's view (gate, backends, service_maxima, presets), not the host's document (table case capabilities.traverse_capabilities_document: 'the raw document and its gate-block projection are not exposed'), so its one property check, capabilities_doc, is not exposed ('field not in the answer: release') and every MCP execution is inconclusive; nothing else is tested there. Tested on direct-local.

not_required.reason: the MCP's traverse records carry no label dictionary ('field not in the answer: results[0].label_dict' on every MCP execution of v3 and v4, VERIFY-B); the walk itself (walk_in_record) stays required on the MCP arm, label_dict_contains on direct-local.
